content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Trades, leases and disassembles used aircraft and parts; does not design or manufacture aircraft like Textron."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Makes electronic instruments and motors for many industries; not an aircraft or defense vehicle maker."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Builds asphalt, aggregate and mining equipment for road builders; different products and customers."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Makes valves, pumps and composite panels; aerospace parts are a minor share, not whole aircraft."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Distributes MRO supplies and test equipment; a distributor rather than an aircraft or vehicle manufacturer."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Makes welding and cutting consumables and equipment for fabricators; no aircraft or defense vehicle overlap."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Mainly utility meters, filtration and test equipment; aerospace valves are a separate, smaller business."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Makes municipal street sweepers and sirens for cities; vehicles serve different government customers than defense."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Makes pumps, valves and seals for process plants; no aviation or defense product overlap."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Makes avionics components for aircraft; a supplier to aircraft makers, not an aircraft or helicopter manufacturer."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Makes pumps, valves, brake pads and connectors; aerospace is a minor component business, not aircraft."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Sells telecom test instruments, optical security materials and software subscriptions; different business model."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Makes barcode printers, scanners and mobile computers for retail and logistics; no aviation or defense overlap."}]}
